debates.reviewOutcome: Overall totals are stable, but the move-adjudication rate exceeds 0.25 and the pro-side mean dimension delta exceeds 5. The main disagreements concern how direct a non-answer remains and how much calibration/charity belongs to bounded closing moves.
All numerical review gates pass. The only burden-adjustment trigger exposed a useful double-counting control: the proposed pro deduction duplicated incompletions already scored in selected moves.

The overall delta remains within threshold, but the pass-level result moves from a tie to a con lead.

gateDecision.reason: The calculations, isolation, inventories, and adjudications are auditable, and overall scores are stable within four points. The preregistered gate nevertheless cannot pass before quote verification and complete composition/novelty QA, and its move-level disagreement rate exceeds the locked review threshold.

workflowFindings: The same rubric is reliable in the close analytic format but materially less reliable when rapid adversarial exchanges or multi-person aggregation make response scope and burden relevance contestable.
Overall aggregation masks local instability: 26 of 79 moves require adjudication even though all six side-level overall pass deltas are four points or less.

Responsiveness, relevanceBurden, and calibrationCharity are the principal disagreement hotspots; the workflow needs sharper examples for partial answers, weaker reconstructions, and the boundaries of a selected closing move.
The burden-completion adjustment control worked when adjudication rejected a duplicate pro deduction in Debate #81, but non-triggered averaging can still retain a small duplicate adjustment.
The three pass producers used semantically equivalent but structurally different JSON layouts, increasing normalization risk despite correct arithmetic.
recommendedRequirementsBeforeExpansion: Adopt one validator-enforced scoring-pass JSON schema before the ten-debate gate.
Add rubric anchor examples for direct-but-nonresponsive replies, diagnostic questions, weaker reconstructions, and calibration scoring confined to the locked move span.
Require audio verification for every medium-confidence selected move and every representative quote before composition is accepted.
Make a burden adjustment ineligible when every cited incompletion already maps to one or more scored moves, unless the rationale identifies a distinct debate-wide consequence.
Complete the three prose scorecards, AI Extensions, novelty maps, and rendering checks before reconsidering the initial gate decision.
